authority: scientist_knowledge hash manifest + bounded Scientist context/store; Owner/backend remain domain authorities.
entry_condition: Scientist status/chat request occurs and knowledge manifest/provider/context prerequisites are valid.
failure_behavior: Stale knowledge, invalid provider response/evidence or uncertain in-flight request blocks authoritative completion/retry.
invariants: Scientist cannot open gates, select for Owner, promote Champion, mutate datasets, change risk or create scientific PASS.
Hash mismatch makes knowledge stale rather than silently using changed docs/source.
Chat/provider state is operational, not scientific authority.
purpose: Load source-hash-verified static knowledge, combine only bounded committed runtime context and produce advisory chat without scientific or promotion mutation authority.
restart_behavior: Chat/request recovery preserves idempotency and does not replay uncertain external provider side effects blindly.
rollback_behavior: Clear/rotate chat may change conversational context only; Strategy/Research authority is untouched.
title: Hash-verified Scientist knowledge to advisory context

transitions.action: Read allowlisted committed Strategy/Research/runtime evidence only.
Build bounded provider request with provenance.
Validate provider output/evidence/classification before returning chat result.
